device.description: 16-bit single-channel programmable current (4-20 mA, 0-20 mA, 0-24 mA) and voltage (0-5/10 V, +/-5/10 V) output DAC with SPI-style serial interface (LATCH), register read-back, CLR/CLR-SEL, watchdog and CRC frame checking
device.note: dac8760.pdf (SBAS528D) p.3-4 pin configuration and Table 6-1, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.12 timing (Figures 7-1, 7-2 on p.13), p.30 DAC clear (Table 8-2), p.32-33 watchdog and frame error checking, p.40-41 SPI (Tables 8-12 to 8-15), p.42-45 register map (Tables 8-16 to 8-23)

registers.name: STATUS
registers.note: Table 8-23 status register (read address xxxx00); read-only, default 0; the alarm sources are analog/timers and never set here

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: Table 8-19 DAC data register (write address 0x01, read address xxxx01); default 0

registers.name: CONTROL
registers.note: Table 8-17 control register, write address 0x55, read address xxxx10; default 0

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.note: Table 8-18 configuration register, write address 0x57, read address 001011; default 0

registers.name: GAIN
registers.note: Table 8-20 DAC gain calibration register, write 0x58, read 010011; default 0

registers.name: ZERO
registers.note: Table 8-21 DAC zero calibration register, write 0x59, read 010111; default 0

Read DAC data register (32-bit CRC frame)

protocol.note: 24-bit frame (32 with CRCEN): address byte + 16-bit data word; bits shift in on SCLK rising regardless of LATCH and are latched at LATCH rising (p.40); a read (0x02) outputs the register in the next frame, first 8 bits don't care (Figure 7-2, p.13)

pages: p.3-4 (pins, Table 6-1), p.5 (DVDD 2.7-5.5 V, internal regulator disabled), p.12 (timing t19 35 ns, t20 35 ns), p.13 (Figures 7-1/7-2), p.30 (CLR, CLR-SEL Table 8-2), p.31 (POR), p.32-33 (watchdog, CRC), p.40-41 (Tables 8-12 to 8-15), p.42-45 (Tables 8-16 to 8-23)
notModeled: analog: voltage output (VOUT, +VSENSE/-VSENSE, CMP compensation, OVR overrange) and 4-20/0-20/0-24 mA current output (IOUT, BOOST, ISET-R/REXT), ranges (CONTROL.RANGE, CONFIG.IOUT_RANGE, DUAL_OUTEN), APD, HART modulation (HART-IN, HARTEN), internal reference

LATCH is not a chip select: data shift in regardless of LATCH (p.41). Modeled as an SPI CS with protocol.align "end" (the last 24/32 bits before LATCH rises are executed); SCLK while LATCH is high is not shifted in the model, and SDO is driven only while LATCH is low
SDO outputs on SCLK falling edges (read data valid on rising): mode 0
CRC-8 frame checking (CRCEN): the 32-bit frame is decoded (commands gated on CONFIG.CRCEN) but the CRC byte is neither checked nor generated (read-back CRC byte output as 0); CRC-FLT is never set
watchdog timer (WDEN/WDPD, 0x95 reset) and WD-FLT: not modeled
ALARM open-drain output (open circuit, compliance, over-temperature, watchdog, CRC) is never asserted; status fault bits stay 0
user calibration (CALEN, GAIN, ZERO): registers stored and read back; the calibrated code is not computed
slew-rate control (SREN, SRCLK, SRSTEP) and SR-ON: not modeled (output change is instant)

CLR (active high) clears to the code the CLR-SEL pin picks for the power-on unipolar range (0: 0 V = zero scale, 1: midscale; Table 8-2, p.30). Not modeled: the CLRSEL bit (ORed with the pin), the bipolar-range codes (0 V = midscale, CLR-SEL = 1 negative full scale), CLR-SEL as the power-on / reset / range-change default output, the restore of the pre-clear value on a LATCH pulse without data, and the CLR-active write lockout
DVDD can be an output of the internal 4.6 V regulator (DVDD-EN floating); DVDD-EN is modeled as a plain digital input and vcc is the external-DVDD range
the reset-register RESET bit self-clears; modeled as a reset command (RESET = 1)
frames with more or fewer than 24 SCLK cycles program incorrect data (p.41); the model takes the last 24 bits
variants: DAC7760 (12-bit) and DAC8760 (16-bit) share dac8760.pdf; both are orderable in HTSSOP (PWP) only, the datasheet also shows the 40-pin RHA VQFN pinout. DAC7750/DAC8750 are the current-output-only versions (dac7750.pdf).
